key_insight: Building rotational symmetry into spherical CNNs reduces the need to learn it from data, improving simulation efficiency for scientific inference.
engineering_relevance: The architecture supports learning on HEALPix spherical data when expensive simulations and arbitrary orientations make conventional CNN training inefficient.
method: Adapt a gauge-equivariant mesh architecture to the HEALPix sphere.
Combine steerable filters, parallel transport and spin-weighted features.
Construct convolutions with provably exact SO(3) equivariance under a band-limit assumption.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports the most accurate dense gradient regression, competitive CMB foreground removal and denoising, and the tightest cosmological lensing posteriors at matched simulation counts.
watch_item: Exact equivariance applies to band-limited convolutions; full-network invariance remains approximate, with reported errors at percent level or lower depending on hyperparameters.
paper_title: Learning without relearning physical symmetry: an SO(3)-equivariant convolutional network (CNN) on the sphere
